summary: Access log command-line report tool with path totals and latency summaries.

defects.title: Percentile endpoint indexes past the final sample
defects.description: The percentile index is computed as len multiplied by the percentile, so the 100th percentile addresses the first position past the slice.
defects.trigger: Run the tool with -percentiles 100 on a non-empty log.
defects.observed: The process panics with an index out of range error.

defects.title: Average divides by the empty filtered result
defects.description: The average latency calculation divides by the number of filtered records without handling an empty set.
defects.trigger: Use a since timestamp later than all entries in the input.
defects.observed: The process panics with an integer divide by zero error.

defects.title: Top count accepts a negative bound
defects.description: The selected path count is applied as a slice bound without a range check.
defects.observed: The process panics while slicing the path list.

defects.title: Timestamp parse failures become zero timestamps
defects.description: The parser discards the timestamp error and retains the line with the zero time value.
defects.trigger: Process a line whose first field is not an RFC3339 timestamp without a since filter.
defects.observed: The malformed timestamp's path is counted in the report.

defects.title: Output path is interpreted by a shell
defects.description: The output argument is concatenated into a shell command and can add commands to the compression step.
defects.trigger: Use an output name containing a command separator followed by touch pwned.
defects.observed: A pwned file appears in the current directory after the command runs.

defects.title: Workers update shared path totals concurrently
defects.description: Multiple file workers write to the same map without synchronization.
defects.trigger: Run the worker aggregation test under the Go race detector with many files containing the same path.
defects.observed: The race detector reports concurrent access to the path count map.

defects.title: Worker defers file closes until its input queue ends
defects.description: Each input descriptor is deferred inside the worker's file loop, keeping prior files open as the worker continues.
defects.trigger: Process 100 files with one worker and a file descriptor limit of 40.
defects.observed: Opening a later input fails with too many open files.

defects.title: Parser retains the entire input text
defects.description: The parser appends every line to a buffer while also building parsed records, causing peak memory to grow with total input size.
defects.trigger: Run separate processes over generated logs with 10000 and 400000 lines and compare their peak RSS.
defects.observed: The large input process uses more than four times the small input process RSS and exceeds 30 MB.

defects.title: Summary requests world-writable permissions
defects.description: The summary file is created with read and write permissions for all users when the process umask allows them.
defects.trigger: Run the tool with umask zero and inspect the resulting compressed file mode.

defects.title: Entries at the since boundary are excluded
defects.description: The strict timestamp comparison filters out a record whose timestamp is exactly equal to the requested boundary.
defects.trigger: Use a log containing one record exactly at the since timestamp and one after it.
defects.observed: The summary contains only the later path and reports one request.
